- When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.27) over recent days, model tends to under-forecast; increase forecast slightly to align with sentiment momentum.  
- When sentiment is negative (≤ -0.26), model often over-forecasts; reduce forecast to match downward sentiment pressure.  
- Model frequently overshoots after sharp price spikes (e.g., +5+ points in 3-5 days); cap forecast rise to 2-3% below true peak.  
- Model underestimates mean reversion in 30-day horizon; add 0.5–1.5% buffer to forecast if recent 7-day average is below 65.  
- If sentiment history shows repeated small up/down swings (±0.18), model tends to lag; adjust forecast to match sentiment direction by +0.3–0.7 points per swing.  
- For 30-day forecasts, if true outcome exceeds model by >3% in 3 consecutive days, reduce next forecast by 0.5–1.0% to avoid overcorrection.
